'''''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia''''' is a [[2008]] reference book written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. [[Bob Vitas]], [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Chris Cassidy]], [[Mary Franklin]], and [[Josh Kushins]] are also contributors for the compendium. It is the second edition of the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.

==Publisher's summary==
'''''The definitive reference guide to a space fantasy phenomenon.'''''

''The ''Star Wars'' universe, much like our own, is constantly expanding. In the ten years since the publication of the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia'', a lot has happened in that galaxy far, far away: four new feature films, a host of official original novels, comics, video games, and more. Now, thirty years of information on all things ''Star Wars''—ranging from science and technology to history and geography, culture and biography to ecology and cosmology—has been supplemented with an entire decade's worth of all-new material. Abundantly illustrated with full-color artwork and photos, and now in a new three-volume addition to accommodate its wealth of detailed entries, the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia'' encompasses the full measure of George Lucas's creation.''

==Development==
During a [[January 28]], [[2004]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] celebrity chat, it was [[Stephen J. Sansweet|Steve Sansweet's]] opinion that there would be a updated edition to the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia''.<ref name="SWBoards 1">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=154418&start=75|thread=Unknown thread|user=[[Stephen J. Sansweet|Steve Sansweet]]|quote=There will almost definitely be an update but no decision has been made how it will be done or by whom.|nobackup=1}}</ref>

Sansweet again confirmed a second ''Encyclopedia'' is on its way at his "Star Wars Spectacular" presentation at ComicCon on [[July 15]], [[2005]]. He explained that he and [[Lucas Licensing]] were still in the process of deciding how to go about writing a new ''Encyclopedia''. He gave an example of the process, saying that they were trying to decide whether to make the new book a second volume or an entirely new ''Encyclopedia''.<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/audiocast/audio/SW_comiccon2005_01_2005-07-15.mp3|text=SW_comiccon2005_01_2005-07-15.mp3|nobackup=1}}</ref>

In a December 2005 post at the StarWars.com message boards, [[Sue Rostoni]] claimed that the format had been decided on; any entries from the first edition of which new information has been revealed will be updated and included in the second edition of the ''Encyclopedia'', while entries with no new information will not be included. She also revealed that the new edition will be written in the same format as the first, and that Lucas Licensing was looking at a possible release date of Fall 2008.<ref name="SWBoards 2">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&messageID=13615282#13615282|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni|Eeusu Estornii]]|date=2005-12-19|time=2:58 PM|quote=It's true, there is a new Encyclopedia in the works. A volume that will update ongoing entries. Stuff that hasn't changed (i.e., "hydrospanner") won't be duplicated in this second volume. A pub date hasn't been set in duracrete yet, but we're looking at Fall 2008 as a possible release time. The format will be the same as the first volume, to keep it as a "set." That's about all that's been discussed at this point.}}</ref>

Sansweet later announced in [[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]] (May/June 2006) that work had begun on an updated version of his ''Star Wars Encyclopedia''.<ref name="SWI87">[[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]]</ref>

At the [[2007]] [[Wikipedia:Comic-Con International|Comic-Con]], the ''Star Wars'' publishing panel revealed that a second edition of the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia'' will be written by Sansweet and [[Pablo Hidalgo]] (the two previously collaborated on ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''), and that it will be published in Fall of [[2008]].<ref name="SWBlog">{{OfficialBlog|url=2007/07/27/star-wars-day-report-publishing-panel|text=Star Wars Day Report: Publishing Panel}}</ref>

In April 2008, [[Random House]] added an entry on ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''; this was subsequently reported by [[Tracy Duncan|Club Jade]].<ref name="CJ">{{WebCite|url=http://clubjade.net/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-look-at-the-size-of-that-thing|text=''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'': Look at the size of that thing!|author=[[Tracy Duncan|Dunc]]|date=2008-04-23|work=[http://clubjade.net Club Jade]|archivedate=20171125084606}}</ref>
